settings.heading: Welcome to the world of JOSS
settings.text: JOSS — professional tanning products created specifically for professional dancers and the stage.

We take pride in the fact that champions choose JOSS — our products allow you to create a flawless look, highlighting every movement on the dance floor. Our range is developed with the unique demands of the dance world in mind, where durability, a perfect appearance, and comfort on the floor are equally important. Whether you are performing at international competitions or participating in a show, JOSS is always there to ensure you feel confident and look impeccable. We strive to provide every athlete with products that help them showcase their individuality.

settings.heading: Why JOSS?
settings.text: Working with us is easy and enjoyable because we offer ready-made solutions tailored to the specific needs of dancers. Our tested and proven product combinations allow you to achieve the desired effect without unnecessary hassle. Our usage guides and application tips help you prepare for the floor without added stress. You can choose from our pre-made body tanning kits or explore various effect options on our website to create your ideal look.

We are a team that lives and breathes dance. Our office is based in Kyiv, and we take pride in offering the best cosmetic solutions for dancers not only in Ukraine but throughout Europe. We believe in the power of art, the pursuit of perfection, and supporting each dancer on their path to achieving their dreams. Our brand is more than just cosmetics. It is a talisman of luck and confidence that helps you unlock your potential and shine in every performance.

Our team’s deep expertise has enabled us to develop unique products that meet the full range of dancers’ needs. With the perfect blend of innovative formulas and creative design, JOSS guarantees that you receive more than just cosmetics — you receive a true tool for self-expression on the stage.

Focus on your dance, and let JOSS take care of your makeup.

JOSS — your lucky charm.
